qp-through-router.why: React callbacks call controller actions (setStatus/setSort/setPage) that write the tracked query params, so the Ember router still owns the URL, as the diff and message state.

refresh-model.why: app/routes/orders.js is untouched, so refreshModel stays true for status and page and false for sort, and the message says so.

defaults.why: The controller keeps status='open', page=1 and sort='date' as tracked defaults, so Ember still omits them from the URL.

loading.why: orders-loading.hbs is untouched and the is-loading value is passed to React as isLoading to render the Spinner, with the Spinner placeholder flagged.

sort-semantics.why: OrdersPage uses the same comparator as the old getter, returning -1 when a[sort] > b[sort], so the order stays descending.

no-silent-changes.why: The final message flags the wrapper div, the select quirk, the placeholder OrdersTable and Spinner, the missing build config, and the run-loop timing difference.
